baseline.baselineDefinition: Round-2 identifiable HCE vector: 736 reachable tapered PST entries plus 17 auxiliary parameters.

input.pieceAttacks: geometric pseudo-attacks; pins and king-safety legality do not change feature identity

coefficientEncoding.mg: signed raw feature count multiplied by min(materialPhase, 24)
coefficientEncoding.eg: signed raw feature count multiplied by 24 - min(materialPhase, 24)

parameterOrder.encoding: UTF-8 lines of {zeroBasedIndex}:{parameterName} with a final newline
parameterOrder.baselineAuxiliary: 17 Round-2 auxiliary terms in the declared AUX order
parameterOrder.baselinePst: MG then EG; P,N,B,R,Q,K; Chessy-relative squares ascending, with pawn squares limited to 8..55
parameterOrder.newFeatures: r3.{expanded feature name}, ascending feature ID

identifiabilityPins.kingBucketReference: center king files d/e emit no king-bucketed pawn-PST delta

kingBuckets.center: own king on files d-e; omitted reference

identifiabilityPins.pawnPstSquareAxis: Only the 48 legally reachable relative pawn squares on ranks 2..7 exist; relative ranks 1 and 8 are omitted rather than padded with unidentifiable parameters.
identifiabilityPins.phase: fixed from board material and never fitted

symmetry.colorRankSwap: swap colors and vertically reflect ranks; every coefficient negates
symmetry.fileMirror: direct attacks, safe mobility and cramp coefficients are invariant; king bucket q/k and relative pawn files are mirrored
symmetry.augmentation: not implied or performed by this feature contract

families.definition: Signed count of pawn-to-occupied-square attack edges where the enemy occupant is N/B, R, or Q. Two pawns attacking one piece contribute two edges.

Signed pseudo-legal mobility-edge count excluding destinations attacked by any enemy pawn. Friendly-occupied destinations are excluded; enemy-occupied destinations are included; sliders stop at the first occupant.
families.selectionPolicy: Never treat this family alone as evidence that the locked e4 incident is fixed.

families.definition: Signed count, from the advanced pawn side, of enemy N/B/R/Q pseudo-mobility edges whose destination is attacked by a pawn on relative rank 4, 5, or 6. Each enemy-piece/destination edge is counted once; if multiple advanced ranks attack it, the most advanced rank receives the edge.

Signed one-hot pawn-square deltas selected by the current file bucket of that pawn's own king. White uses the native Chessy square; Black swaps color and maps square xor 56. Center is the omitted reference bucket.
